text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy☆ Before we watch, let's hit up the 
Hachimi stand-♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Today I'll get ice cream instead of a 
drink♪ Hey big sis! One Hachimi ice cream, 
please☆

text_block_list.name: Hachimii Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Yes, Helios-chan. Just a single scoop?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!? Kinda lame, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hachimii Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Then, a double?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Non-non☆ Let's hype it up even more!?

text_block_list.name: Hachimii Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: I-It can't be...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy, make mine a triple, pleeease★☆▲!! 
'Cause today is—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's an insanely hype, maxed-out Mejiro, 
Mejiro, Mejiro showdown☆

The Kikuka Sho, crowning the end of the 
Classic Road, became a dream three-way 
showdown between the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, making her entrance first is none 
other than the star who has stolen the 
spotlight throughout the Classic series—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: I'm Mejiro Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next, one of the high-society ladies who 
rose through the summer, Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And last of all, the ultra-free-spirited 
runner, Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeek—no, I mean!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you! ...Or 
something like that?

A modest party-animal style. Yet, it seems 
she's learned to assert herself just a 
little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, welcome. To my garden... the long 
distance races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nice to meet you! Not like I came 
here to get in the way or anything, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's no need to hold back, is 
there? Come at me with everything you've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you have always 
reprimanded me since long ago, whenever I 
lost my temper.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean... yeah. It was pretty much 
my duty, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but... Things won't go that way 
today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This resolve to bring glory back to 
Mejiro... if anyone thinks they can stop 
it, I would like to see them try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
These feelings of mine—my most passionate 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Going head-to-head might be a bit 
too heavy to handle... But still...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it, don't sweat it. I'll just 
go at my own pace. Yep!
